phase: E13-R1-DESIGN open questions for human approval

A_streak_length.evidence: Legacy P4C required 3 consecutive (min 5 cycles, max 30). R11/R12 used 3. R13A needed 3 after reset to distinguish excursion from closure.
A_streak_length.risk_if_2: false positive with transient PASS (e.g., N400 50,52 only 2 not yet stable after 54 FAIL)
A_streak_length.risk_if_4: requires longer horizon (e.g., N400 would need 62, extra 2 cycles 31-46s each) without scientific gain

B_precedence.reason: period-1 implies period-2 PASS; without precedence period-1 would be misclassified as period-2

C_branch_reset.proposal: FAIL in one branch does not reset the other
C_branch_reset.evidence: R13A 54 FAIL resets even only, odd remains 6

D_both_branches.reason: ANY would allow N400 51 (odd 6) with even 1 to converge falsely

E_thresholds.evidence: R13A 56 vs 54 sensor 0.00119 PASS under same thresholds; R11 D1 0.60 FAIL expected

F_period_gt2.proposal: GEN1 does not support period>2; declare UNSUPPORTED_PERIODICITY
F_period_gt2.risk_generic: overfitting to noise, requires N histories, not evidenced

G_restart_persist.proposal: restart must persist detector state (streaks, anchor, metrics)
G_restart_persist.tradeoff: persist 1KB state vs replay up to 5 cycles (100-200s) to rebuild streaks; if FULL_DEBUG missing, recompute impossible

H_branch_identity.proposal: anchor_cycle = start_cycle of orbit, branch = (cycle - anchor) %2
H_branch_identity.issue: absolute parity breaks after restart at 50 (odd/even flips relative to orbit origin)

I_invalid_handling.proposal: missing n-2 => INVALID (reset affected streak only; never scientific FAIL)
I_invalid_handling.reason: INVALID breaks consecutivity without asserting non-convergence; a later PASS must rebuild three comparisons

J_configuration_identity.proposal: detector state requires matching configuration_hash, scientific_contract_id, solver/backend, mesh, geometry, RPM and cycle convention; mismatch => INVALID and affected reset
J_configuration_identity.alternative: continue from physical state without identity checks
J_configuration_identity.reason: streaks cannot be transported between scientific configurations

next_step: human review of docs/gasdynamic/e13_r1_periodicity_contract_proposal.md and artifacts; no E13-R1 implementation until approved
